description: This file defines the Smarty_Internal_Compile_Extends class, which handles the compilation of the {extends} tag in the Smarty template engine. It includes methods for compiling the tag, handling inheritance end-child logic, including subtemplates, and generating source code for extending templates.

classes.name: Smarty_Internal_Compile_Extends
classes.description: Handles parsing and compiling of the {extends} tag in Smarty templates, managing template inheritance, include statements, and template source code generation.

methods.name: compile
methods.description: Processes the {extends} tag attributes and generates the PHP code to handle template inheritance.

methods.name: compileEndChild
methods.description: Adds code to close out inheritance, including calling endChild() and handling included subtemplates.

methods.name: compileInclude
methods.description: Includes a subtemplate into the current template with scope 'parent'.

methods.name: extendsSourceArrayCode
methods.description: Generates PHP code for {extends} based on components of the template source.
